a pigeon stole your homework
your soup started telling jokes
your friend turned into a turtle
the moon showed up an hour early
your shadow wandered off without you
a goose is doing your taxes
your left shoe learned to whistle
the vending machine gave you a live crab
your reflection waved back a second too late
a squirrel just quoted Shakespeare at you
your sandwich filed a complaint
the elevator sang you a lullaby
your houseplant asked to borrow the car
gravity took the afternoon off
your umbrella opened inward and it started raining glitter
the toaster proposed marriage
a very small horse is running the meeting
your coffee began reciting poetry
the mailbox ate today's letters and burped
your bicycle rode away on its own
a cloud parked itself in your living room
the cat unionized with the neighborhood dogs
your alarm clock apologized and let you sleep
a stranger returned the exact pen you lost in 2009
the escalator started going sideways
your dinner plate winked at you
a wizard mistook you for his cousin
the printer finally worked on the first try
your keys hid inside a loaf of bread
the ocean asked for directions
